notes: Maker page holds EVO 1 and EVO 2 configurators; EVO 1 specs are in hidden configurator/tab content (read via page text). Maker shows no price for the Performance (Class 1) version, only Performance Sport $4,599; price is from the Electric Bike Journal review. Maker contradicts itself on height: spec table says 5'1"-6'1", sizing section says 'FITS WIDE RANGE OF RIDERS 5’1”/155CM – 6’2”/188CM'. Maker spec table says GEN 3 motor, configurator says 'PERFORMANCE – SMART SYSTEM GEN4'. Review says 65Nm vs maker 75Nm. Maker gives only a gross weight (420 lb total); rack rated 'Max. Load 130lbs/60kg'. EBR only has the non-XL RemiDemi 9D; EBReport had no review. Used 1 WebSearch. recheck (cls): maker page full text has no class wording or throttle; Boulder Nordic only stocks the XL Performance Line Sport (Class 3); added BikeRide (bikeride.com) review summary stating the 20 mph build is Class 1 (it does not name the EVO generation). Bosch's US site lists an XL 9D Performance CX EVO 2 (other generation, not used). Used the bike's one WebSearch.
